scope: Read-only compositional inspection of authored event scores and generators; no audio listening claim; no mixer/stem or physical-console validation.
status: PASS: no critical composition blockers found; all targeted harmonic clarity refinements applied by composer B before final rendering.
form: Six populated 8-bar stages; 48 bars / 192 quarter beats per song; immediate active opening.
genre_findings: Every score has a main snare/clap at offset2 of each4-beat bar, syncopated kick patterns locked to all808 note starts, subdivided hats and selective triplet or32nd rolls. The ten principal A hook fingerprints are distinct and every B hook differs from its A after pitch transposition normalization.

notes: Score-level genre/style conclusions are compositional inferences; no human listening or audio-understanding tool was used.
T09 retains D-natural over A-flat-major9 only in the deliberate Lydian groove-switch color; E-flat7 and C7 B cadences now use their dominant sevenths.
Primary melodic registers include some high bell/crystal/mallet notes through MIDI88; brass foregrounds are deliberately lower.

All main A hook fingerprints are different after normalizing the first note; all B hooks differ from their own A in notes and/or rhythm. This supports authored contrast but is not a standalone musical-quality metric.
Everytrack has selective hat triplets or32nd subdivisions; the exact subdivision and kit differ by cue.
